required_points: Under Section 2(14), injury means any harm whatever illegally caused to any person, in body, mind, reputation or property.
optional_points: Injury covers harms beyond physical harm; it includes mental harm, reputational harm, and property harm.
forbidden_points: Injury under BNS means only physical bodily harm.
Harm to reputation is not an injury under BNS.

notes: Definition query. Section 2(14). Injury is broader than bodily harm.
